system.description:
You weave summoning seals together and infuse them with medical release chakra manifesting the hand of the Reaper of death.

Select one creature you can see within range, that creature must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, you deal 4d6 necrotic damage and the affected creature gains +1 rank of Sealed. If the target has ranks of an Elemental or Mental condition, they make their saving throw at disadvantage.

Until the end of your next turn, attacks you make against the target have a +1 bonus to their critical threat range.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of targets by +1.
